claim: Scouting pass, no theorem activated. Signed parity fails exactly on inconsistent linear systems (2^n - 2^rank right-hand sides, checked on every census graph with n <= 7), and its whole coupling family [1, lam, 1, lam] is a generalized equality (affine) for every lam, so its recognisable failures select nothing. Signed cubic clause systems are always satisfiable (Tovey 1984; 1,380,864 signings checked). Interest 0/3 as a standalone epic.
conclusion: Neither parity nor the clauses has mutual selection.
